sum: Gives an agent a browser it can actually use: pages, clicks, forms and extraction, driven from a task written in words.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine; keys are the operator's own (byok)
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2/T3/T11 introduced, controls sandbox part, allowlist none, egress none, approval none, log part
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry executes, and its reach is bounded by approval none, sandbox part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format ephemeral-path: a path that exists for the run; nothing durable survives it
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets in configuration: browser_use/config.py (max_tokens:)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: pyproject.toml (click)
evidence.rl.resume: recovering is described in prose, not implemented: README.md (resume a)
evidence.fx.install: only a global install is documented: README.md (pip install b)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: GOOGLE, ANTHROPIC, OLLAMA, BEDROCK, OPENAI, DEEPSEEK (README.md)

pre: a browser runtime and somewhere to run it
anti: anything where a wrong click has consequences, since the agent decides where to click
gnote: A browser is the widest tool surface a harness can be given: it reaches every service the operator is logged into. This is also one of the few entries that can observe a rendered interface, which is why the UI domain applies to it and to almost nothing else here.

ja.sum: エージェントに実際に使えるブラウザを与える。ページを開き、クリックし、フォームを埋め、情報を取り出す。指示は言葉で書く。
ja.art: ブラウザセッションと抽出データ（使い捨て）
pre: ブラウザ実行環境とその置き場所
自動操作を許容する対象
anti: 誤クリックが実害になる対象。どこを押すかはエージェントが決める
自動化を禁じている利用規約のサイト
ja.gnote: ブラウザはハーネスに与えうる最も広いツール表面で、利用者がログイン済みのあらゆるサービスに届く。描画された画面を観測できる数少ないツールでもあり、UIドメインがここと他のごく一部にしか付かない理由でもある。
ja.ui_ux_note: 規定はせず、描画された画面を評価する。仕様を書いて結果を見ないツールの、ちょうど反対側の半分。

ui_ux.note: It evaluates a rendered interface without specifying one, which is the opposite half of the open cycle from the tools that specify without evaluating.
